limits: For red and rosé wine, Grenache and Lledoner Pelut together: at least 20%
For red and rosé wine, Mourvèdre: at least 5%
For red and rosé wine, Carignan: 10 to 40%
For red and rosé wine, Cinsault: at most 20%
For white wine, Roussanne: at least 30%

blurb.text: A Languedoc appellation in the foothills of the Massif Central north of Béziers. Its wines are made from Grenache, Syrah, Mourvèdre and Lledoner Pelut for red, and Marsanne, Roussanne, Vermentino and Grenache Blanc for white.
